metadata.description: Claude Code and Codex workflows for fast, thorough, and cross-model feature development

plugins.name: sa
plugins.description: Simple Agents for Claude Code — command-free skills + subagents for fast single-feature development: plan, approve, isolate in a worktree, implement, PR — Sonnet build / Opus review

plugins.name: ha
plugins.description: Claude Code Higher Agents — build ONE feature thoroughly with a deep red-teamed plan, SDD per-task loop, risk-scaled pre-PR gate, independent review, feedback handling, gated merge, conflict resolution, and cleanup. Requires superpowers; model-agnostic

plugins.name: ca
plugins.description: Cooperate Agents — Claude×Codex loop: red-team a milestone plan, implement test-first on a draft PR with Claude checkpoints, run a blind-Claude plus offline-Codex final review, promote only on a validated verdict, then merge and clean up worktrees
